data.underfill_policy: stop_and_report_before_fit; no source substitution or threshold relaxation
data.calibration_frame: metadata only: top nonheader discussion or main nonredirect page, original 200..20000 CP, old/diagnostic excluded; hash32 initial components/source before body eligibility
data.calibration_post_union_underfill: stop if any source has fewer than32 final calibration components; no automatic replacement
data.candidate_frame_freeze: after then-known old/diagnostic/calibration exclusions, before all body qualification; hash3000/1500/1500 records; never backfill subsequent rejection
data.unresolved_concrete_lineage_edges: conservative union or quarantine before split; never unresolved crossing
data.generic_geography_or_unknown_author: sensitivity metadata, not automatically a work/copy edge or verified independence
data.old_exposure_fingerprint_gap: G2 remains blocked until separately root-authorized one-time offline fingerprint derivation from existing licensed sources completes and is audited
data.member_key: canonical JSON[canonical_origin,project,object_id]; wikiconv/discussion/mediawiki aliases map to wikimedia origin; project-specific page IDs normalized decimal; unknown aliases rejected
data.exclusion_propagation: expand old component members/ancestry; any excluded-member contamination excludes whole new union component, irrespective of changed component hash
data.direct_body_reading_exposure: assistant/human reads or projection-debug uses register exposure before use; entire final component excluded; automatic frozen rules only for future test candidates

measurement.global_missing: first four summaries zero only when no values; opportunity sum independently known; fractions disambiguate
measurement.global_scaling: first five summaries train-only record-equal/source-equal over legal prefixes; two support fractions unscaled

targets.dependency_opportunity: legal nonroot lexical-to-lexical arcs within next unit
targets.common_target_ledger: all four heads defined; POS-only auxiliary coverage separately
targets.composite: equal mean of four proper marginal losses; not joint likelihood or style score
targets.record_average: targets within record -> eligible records within source -> equal three-source average

models.unknown_implementation_details_require_g: exact graph transforms and parameter hash receipt before natural target extraction

optimization.checkpoint: lowest dev source-equal composite; exact ties earliest epoch

evaluation.primary: paired_record seed-mean SG loss minus DG loss, source-equal macro
evaluation.positive_evidence_rule: primary 95% interval lower bound >0 and every source-frame point estimate >=0; scoped to frozen observed-output task, not product utility
evaluation.bootstrap_rule: stratify within three sources; resample components or source-qualified attribution clusters, retaining member multiplicities; source-equal aggregate; <2 clusters in any source -> undefined
evaluation.primary_interpretation: approximately capacity-matched architecture comparison, not an isolated causal order effect

layout_lane.semantic_gate: lexical identity mechanical only; independent pass/fail/uncertain review required
layout_lane.later_reuse_of_unsealed_A_test: diagnostic_only; new confirmatory layout test needed
layout_lane.neutral_unitization: remove whitespace, fixed punctuation-only segmentation from same neutral character sequence; no reuse of A units/features/graph; original offsets only label/provenance sidecar
layout_lane.invariance_test: same nonwhitespace chars with different original paragraph boundaries -> identical complete unit spans/features/graph/context and neutral candidate positions

baselines.latest: 0.9 observed latest unit composition/log-length +0.1 source prior; missing opportunity -> source prior; recurrence head uses source prior
